description: Extends icarGroupEventCoreResource to provide a group movement departure event.

departureKind.description: Coded description of the type of departure (e.g. sale, agistment, other).

departureReason.description: Coded description of the reason why the animals are departing.

consignment.description: Consignment information about origin, destination, and transport.

extendedReasons.description: Extended reason codes why these animals have departed.

diagnosisCode.description: Used with 'Health' reason to expand on health reasons for departure. Use ICAR (https://www.icar.org/guidelines/icar-central-health-key/) or VENOM coding scheme.
